correctness.rationale: The three closed-neighborhood formulas for the outer and middle layers in RESULT.md imply four necessary-and-sufficient occupancy regimes. These give an exact generating polynomial; maximality yields the three-singleton configurations and a disjoint family of maximum-cardinality configurations. A complete edge-type analysis of legal single slides identifies two rook grids linked only via a middle-layer hub, plus \(2^n\) isolates. Distance to the diagonal controls the connected-core diameter. The packaged verify.py directly checked every vertex subset for \(n=4,5,6,7\) (2,396,160 cases), all polynomial coefficients, all maximality predicates, every slide edge, components and diameters. The general statement follows from the proof, not from finite tests.

originality.rationale: No examined primary or indexed result implied the combined all-set, maximal-set and maximum-irredundance slide-graph theorem on \(K_n\square P_3\). The general 2018 IR-graph framework provides definitions and broad constraints, not this exact source-family calculation. The 2023 Cartesian well-dominated classification has this product family but a different conclusion; non-well-dominatedness does not imply the quantitative irredundance distribution or reconfiguration graph. A published complete-multipartite irredundance classification is inapplicable because these graphs are not complete multipartite. The 2018 claw-free enumeration work addresses an excluded graph class. Publication-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed or stronger differently formulated work.

value.rationale: The IR-graph is a standard exact reconfiguration invariant whose structure is usually hard to infer from a scalar optimum. Here a connected family of input graphs has exponentially many isolated maximum solutions but exactly one other component, with n-independent diameter 4 and explicit rook-graph decomposition. The full and maximal irredundance polynomials give size spectra and multiplicities, showing unbounded lower/upper irredundance gap and sharply distinguishing availability of optimum solutions from ability to traverse them. This is a motivated complete classification, not a parameter relabeling or isolated small example.
